text:
maria (partnerships): Heads up — CloudArc goes live in the marketplace next Wednesday. We need a concise partner fast-path escalation ladder and a shared ops channel for any SEV. Who can take lead on drafting the ladder?

jason (eng-sre): I can own runtime triage and the initial SRE escalation. Propose we create a dedicated channel (e.g. `#partners-cloudarc-escalation`) and wire PagerDuty to it for critical alerts.

kevin (sales): Contractually CloudArc expects response SLAs: critical <= 2h, but partner engineering expects faster. For marketplace listing let's target ack within 15 minutes for criticals, escalate to Redwood SRE after 15m if unacknowledged. That ok?

sophia (platform): Sounds reasonable. Draft runbook suggestion:
```
1) Partner files support ticket + posts in shared channel
2) PagerDuty triggers a page to the on-call SRE team and posts to the shared channel
3) If not ACK in 15m -> escalate to escalation lead (on-call + eng-sre lead)
4) If impact spans >3 services or revenue-impacting -> spin up a war room and invite eng, partnerships, CS, and partner SRE
```

elaine (solutions): I'll collect CloudArc on-call names and PM info, plus their escalation matrix. Also confirming whether they want Redwood to create the channel or they will. I can handle a short partner-facing doc with who does what.

maria (partnerships): Nice. Two additional asks: 1) add a quick triage checklist in the channel pinned message, 2) set message retention to 90 days for audit.

jason (eng-sre): I'll create the channel and add the bot hooks. Quick sample pinned checklist (pin this once channel exists):
- State: SEV level (S1/S2)
- Services affected + endpoint list
- Short reproducible steps
- Attach logs & trace IDs
- Current mitigation attempts
- Point of contact (name + phone)

deploy-bot: Created channel #partners-cloudarc-escalation and added eng-sre, partnerships, platform teams.

kevin (sales): Who is escalation lead during US mornings next week? Need a named backup for the partner.

sophia (platform): I'll be primary Monday morning; jason backup. I'll add the rotation to the channel topic.

elaine (solutions): Action items: @maria draft partner doc and share by EOD today; @jason create channel + PD integration now; @sophia add rotation and create pinned checklist; @kevin confirm partner contact & SLA language.

maria (partnerships): Thanks everyone — let's treat this as the canonical path for CloudArc marketplace incidents. If anyone wants to change wording for the partner-facing doc ping me directly. :thumbsup:
